## Principal comparison

The causal ordering is:

`A0 → A0 + wavelet → A0 + wavelet + SSL`.

E1 is reserved for the matched complementarity contrast
`A0+wavelet+SSL` versus `E1+wavelet+SSL`. This prevents architectural changes
from being credited to wavelets or SSL.

## Metric-Space UMAP Manifolds Across 115 Completed Wavelet Models

To understand the global structural relationships among all 115 completed 1-lead wavelet and SSL screening configurations, we project the 22-dimensional performance space (spanning reconstruction loss, Pearson correlations, P/QRS/T wave IoUs, boundary F1/PPV/sensitivity, training losses, and peak VRAM footprint) into 2D and 3D non-linear UMAP manifolds:

```{python}
#| label: wavelet-umap-metric-manifold
import umap
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# Extract all numeric metric columns with valid coverage
metric_cols_all = [c for c in completed.columns if c.startswith("metric.") and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(completed[c])]
valid_umap_metrics = [c for c in metric_cols_all if completed[c].notna().sum() > 80 and completed[c].std() > 1e-6]

X_wave = completed[valid_umap_metrics].fillna(completed[valid_umap_metrics].median()).values
X_wave_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X_wave)

reducer_wave_2d = umap.UMAP(n_components=2, n_neighbors=10, min_dist=0.2, random_state=42)
u_wave_2d = reducer_wave_2d.fit_transform(X_wave_scaled)
completed["UMAP1"] = u_wave_2d[:, 0]
completed["UMAP2"] = u_wave_2d[:, 1]

fig_wave_umap2d = px.scatter(
    completed, x="UMAP1", y="UMAP2",
    color="cell.wavelet_bank", symbol="cell.ssl_mode",
    size="metric.miou_wave", hover_name="id",
    hover_data=["cell.name", "metric.val_missing_pearson", "metric.boundary_f1_smoke", "metric.P_iou", "metric.T_iou"],
    labels={"UMAP1": "Wavelet Metric UMAP 1", "UMAP2": "Wavelet Metric UMAP 2",
            "cell.wavelet_bank": "Wavelet Filter Bank", "cell.ssl_mode": "SSL Mode"},
    title="2D Metric-Space UMAP: Global Clustering of 115 Wavelet & SSL Screening Runs"
)
fig_wave_umap2d.update_layout(height=600)
fig_wave_umap2d.show()

reducer_wave_3d = umap.UMAP(n_components=3, n_neighbors=10, min_dist=0.2, random_state=42)
u_wave_3d = reducer_wave_3d.fit_transform(X_wave_scaled)
completed["UMAP3D_1"] = u_wave_3d[:, 0]
completed["UMAP3D_2"] = u_wave_3d[:, 1]
completed["UMAP3D_3"] = u_wave_3d[:, 2]

fig_wave_umap3d = px.scatter_3d(
    completed, x="UMAP3D_1", y="UMAP3D_2", z="UMAP3D_3",
    color="cell.wavelet_bank", symbol="cell.ssl_mode",
    size="metric.val_missing_pearson", hover_name="id",
    hover_data=["cell.name", "metric.miou_wave", "metric.boundary_f1_smoke"],
    labels={"UMAP3D_1": "UMAP 1", "UMAP3D_2": "UMAP 2", "UMAP3D_3": "UMAP 3"},
    title="3D Metric-Space UMAP Manifold Across 115 Completed Queue Runs"
)
fig_wave_umap3d.update_traces(marker=dict(opacity=0.85))
fig_wave_umap3d.update_layout(height=650)
fig_wave_umap3d.show()
```

## Multi-Metric Collinearity & Correlation Matrix

Analyzing cross-endpoint correlations across all 22 evaluation, delineation, and computational metrics reveals how different diagnostic objectives interact:

```{python}
#| label: wavelet-metric-correlation-heatmap
clean_metric_names = [m.replace("metric.", "") for m in valid_umap_metrics]
df_metrics = completed[valid_umap_metrics].copy()
df_metrics.columns = clean_metric_names
corr_metrics = df_metrics.corr()

fig_corr_heat = px.imshow(
    corr_metrics, text_auto=".2f", aspect="auto",
    color_continuous_scale="RdBu_r", zmin=-1.0, zmax=1.0,
    title="Comprehensive Multi-Metric Correlation Matrix Across 115 Wavelet Queue Runs"
)
fig_corr_heat.update_layout(height=750)
fig_corr_heat.show()
```

## Highest-value physiological contrast

At matched TimeSformer, BYOL objective, optimizer, compute, seed, observed lead,
and fusion, compare:

- Morlet magnitude + Morlet phase
- Morlet magnitude + UEG-repolarization phase

If the second improves primarily T-on and T-off rather than all boundaries, it
supports—without proving—the hypothesis that the physiology of the second SSL
view matters. A generic lift could instead reflect regularization, scaling, or
view difficulty.

## Boundary-localization requirement

RDB supervision provides six real boundary channels: P/QRS/T onset and offset.
It does not provide peaks. Any physiology claim must report channel-level
validity and timing error, not only macro IoU. T-peak must remain absent rather
than being synthesized from an interval midpoint or detector.

## Promotion gate

Promote a configuration only after matched incremental improvement, seed and
lead replication, no reconstruction regression beyond a prespecified margin,
boundary-localized analysis, checkpoint provenance, and blinded LUDB/RDB
evaluation. Otherwise label it exploratory.
